exposure: neonatal exposure to antibiotics (with negative cultures)
cohort: The cohort consists of 72 term-born infants, 15 of whom were exposed to antibiotics soon after birth (with negative cultures) and 57 unexposed.
finding: Otherwise healthy infants exposed to antibiotics soon after birth demonstrated altered auditory processing and recognition memory responses at 1 month of age, specifically smaller P2 amplitudes and a reversed response to mother's vs. stranger's voice.
